overall.verdict: The desktop dark variant demonstrates strong execution of the xln wallet's core design principles, particularly in hierarchy, data legibility, and trust cues. The visceral value concept is well-implemented but needs more consistent application across all screens. The premium dark aesthetic is successfully achieved with minimal visual noise and excellent contrast.
priority_fixes: Consistently apply visceral value bars across all screens, especially in modals and list views
Increase text size and contrast for scale indicators and capacity information
Remove redundant information and streamline tooltips
Enhance trust cues in payment and receive flows
Standardize helper text sizes across the application
